text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The final race of the Classic Triple 
Crown. Having finished running the Kikuka 
Sho—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite a glorious 1st-place finish, 
Mihono Bourbon felt deep regret over not 
being able to achieve the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next, to achieve her second goal—the dream 
of "inspiring courage" in others—she 
decides to enter the "Tenno Sho (Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, Mihono Bourbon remembered 
Rice Shower during the Kikuka Sho race, 
feeling an unsettling stir in her chest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The same happened when she heard rumors of 
the powerhouse Tokai Teio. It seemed an 
"awareness of other Umamusume," something 
she'd never had before, had begun to 
sprout.
